The white 'by submitting to' and 'Xavier Sport Program' text sit on the bright green ball with almost no contrast, and the text is scattered across the canvas, so the brand panel is lost. B: the headline is still white on the busy racket/strings with no panel behind it, and the blue panel is split into a sliver at the top and a block at the bottom.
